verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَيُّوبُ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: And Job answered and said,
verses.web: Then Job answered,

verses.ar: «صَحِيحٌ إِنَّكُمْ أَنْتُمْ شَعْبٌ وَمَعَكُمْ تَمُوتُ ٱلْحِكْمَةُ!
verses.kjv: No doubt but ye [are] the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.web: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

verses.ar: غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لِي فَهْمٌ مِثْلَكُمْ. لَسْتُ أَنَا دُونَكُمْ. وَمَنْ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ؟
verses.kjv: But I have understanding as well as you; I [am] not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.web: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

verses.ar: رَجُلًا سُخْرَةً لِصَاحِبِهِ صِرْتُ. دَعَا ٱللهَ فَٱسْتَجَابَهُ. سُخْرَةٌ هُوَ ٱلصِّدِّيقُ ٱلْكَامِلُ.
verses.kjv: I am [as] one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright [man is] laughed to scorn.
verses.web: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

verses.ar: لِلْمُبْتَلِي هَوَانٌ فِي أَفْكَارِ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنِّ، مُهَيَّأٌ لِمَنْ زَلَّتْ قَدَمُهُ.
verses.kjv: He that is ready to slip with [his] feet [is as] a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.web: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

verses.ar: خِيَامُ ٱلْمُخَرِّبِينَ مُسْتَرِيحَةٌ، وَٱلَّذِينَ يُغِيظُونَ ٱللهَ مُطْمَئِنُّونَ، ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْتُونَ بِإِلَهِهِمْ فِي يَدِهِمْ!
verses.kjv: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth [abundantly].
verses.web: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

verses.ar: «فَٱسْأَلِ ٱلْبَهَائِمَ فَتُعَلِّمَكَ، وَطُيُورَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ فَتُخْبِرَكَ.
verses.kjv: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.web: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

verses.ar: أَوْ كَلِّمِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَتُعَلِّمَكَ، وَيُحَدِّثَكَ سَمَكُ ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.web: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

verses.ar: مَنْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ هَؤُلَاءِ أَنَّ يَدَ ٱلرَّبِّ صَنَعَتْ هَذَا؟
verses.kjv: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
verses.web: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ نَفَسُ كُلِّ حَيٍّ وَرُوحُ كُلِّ ٱلْبَشَرِ.
verses.kjv: In whose hand [is] the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.web: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

verses.ar: أَفَلَيْسَتِ ٱلْأُذُنُ تَمْتَحِنُ ٱلْأَقْوَالَ، كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْحَنَكَ يَسْتَطْعِمُ طَعَامَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.web: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

verses.ar: عِنْدَ ٱلشَّيْبِ حِكْمَةٌ، وَطُولُ ٱلْأَيَّامِ فَهْمٌ.
verses.kjv: With the ancient [is] wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.web: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

verses.ar: «عِنْدَهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةُ وَٱلْقُدْرَةُ. لَهُ ٱلْمَشُورَةُ وَٱلْفِطْنَةُ.
verses.kjv: With him [is] wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.web: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

verses.ar: هُوَذَا يَهْدِمُ فَلَا يُبْنَى. يُغْلِقُ عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ فَلَا يُفْتَحُ.
verses.kjv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.web: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

verses.ar: يَمْنَعُ ٱلْمِيَاهَ فَتَيْبَسُ. يُطْلِقُهَا فَتَقْلِبُ ٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.web: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.ar: عِنْدَهُ ٱلْعِزُّ وَٱلْفَهْمُ. لَهُ ٱلْمُضِلُّ وَٱلْمُضَلُّ.
verses.kjv: With him [is] strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver [are] his.
verses.web: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.ar: يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْمُشِيرِينَ أَسْرَى، وَيُحَمِّقُ ٱلْقُضَاةَ.
verses.kjv: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.web: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

verses.ar: يَحُلُّ مَنَاطِقَ ٱلْمُلُوكِ، وَيَشُدُّ أَحْقَاءَهُمْ بِوِثَاقٍ.
verses.kjv: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.web: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

verses.ar: يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْكَهَنَةِ أَسْرَى، وَيَقْلِبُ ٱلْأَقْوِيَاءَ.
verses.kjv: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.web: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

verses.ar: يَقْطَعُ كَلَامَ ٱلْأُمَنَاءِ، وَيَنْزِعُ ذَوْقَ ٱلشُّيُوخِ.
verses.kjv: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.web: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

verses.ar: يُلْقِي هَوَانًا عَلَى ٱلشُّرَفَاءِ، وَيُرْخِي مِنْطَقَةَ ٱلْأَشِدَّاءِ.
verses.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.web: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

verses.ar: يَكْشِفُ ٱلْعَمَائِقَ مِنَ ٱلظَّلَامِ، وَيُخْرِجُ ظِلَّ ٱلْمَوْتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ.
verses.kjv: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.web: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

verses.ar: يُكَثِّرُ ٱلْأُمَمَ ثُمَّ يُبِيدُهَا. يُوَسِّعُ لِلْأُمَمِ ثُمَّ يُجْلِيهَا.
verses.kjv: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them [again].
verses.web: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

verses.ar: يَنْزِعُ عُقُولَ رُؤَسَاءِ شَعْبِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَيُضِلُّهُمْ فِي تِيهٍ بِلَا طَرِيقٍ.
verses.kjv: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness [where there is] no way.
verses.web: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.ar: يَتَلَمَّسُونَ فِي ٱلظَّلَامِ وَلَيْسَ نُورٌ، وَيُرَنِّحُهُمْ مِثْلَ ٱلسَّكْرَانِ.
verses.kjv: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like [a] drunken [man].
verses.web: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
